name: Tales from the Emerald grove
source:
"Tales from the Emerald grove" is a linear, light hearted adult visual novel with fantasy and comedy elements.  You play as Luke, a lost fox who ends up on a mysterious island. You meet new friends and have crazy (and sexy) adventures in this new and exciting world.

[From [url=https://bearyjack.itch.io/tales-from-the-emerald-grove]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《翡翠林的故事》是一部线性、轻松的成人视觉小说，带有奇幻和喜剧元素。你扮演卢克，一只迷路的狐狸，最终流落到一座神秘的岛屿上。你会遇到新朋友，并在这个令人兴奋的新世界中经历疯狂（和性感）的冒险。

[来自[url=https://bearyjack.itch.io/tales-from-the-emerald-grove]Itch.io[/url]]
